question: Which of the following colloids has a solid dispersed phase in a liquid dispersion medium?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sol**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Colloids** are mixtures where one substance is dispersed evenly in another.
 
• The classification depends on the **state** (solid, liquid, gas) of both the **dispersed phase** and the **dispersion medium**.
 
• A sol is a **colloid where the dispersed phase is solid** and the **dispersion medium is liquid**.
 
• Examples of sol include **paint**, **ink**, and **muddy water**.
